parameters.name: CertifyId
parameters.description: Certificate ID, used for whitelisting this specific authenticated user.

parameters.name: ServiceCode
parameters.description:
Service type:
- **antcloudauth**: Financial-grade real-person authentication.
- **cloudauthst** (discontinued): Enhanced real-person authentication.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: Visitor's source IP address. No need to fill in, the system will automatically obtain it.

parameters.name: ValidDay
parameters.description: Number of valid days after creating the whitelist.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudauth create-whitelist-setting --source-ip 27.115.63.58 --lang zh --service-code antcloudauth --scene-id 1000014526 --certify-id sha6d0405f42926084e396e76a037d00 --cert-no 44018219950810XXXX --valid-day 7 --remark '测试白名单。' --whitelist-type SUPER --api-version 2019-03-07 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudauth CreateWhitelistSetting --region cn-hangzhou --SceneId 1000014526 --SourceIp '27.115.63.58' --ServiceCode antcloudauth --CertifyId sha6d0405f42926084e396e76a037d00 --ValidDay 7 --Lang zh --WhitelistType SUPER --CertNo 44018219950810XXXX --Remark '测试白名单。'
